summary: Pan American Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, attaching a National Instrument 43-101 Technical Report for its La Colorada Mine in Zacatecas, Mexico, effective March 24, 2026. The filing is a routine regulatory disclosure of mineral resource estimates under Canadian standards, accompanied by consents and certificates of qualified persons. It does not involve any transaction, corporate action, or strategic event. The report updates mineral resource data for the mine and includes cautionary notes to U.S. investors regarding differences between Canadian and SEC disclosure standards. No deal terms, board recommendations, or event-driven catalysts are present.
